classmate.definition: A child who is in the same class as you. Classmates are the easiest people to be friends with.
classmate.example: Mai is my classmate, and she sits next to me.

embassy.definition: The official office of your country in another country. It issues your passport and provides consular help.
embassy.example: The embassy gave me an emergency document the same morning.

favour.definition: A kind thing you do for someone. You can do it without being paid back at once.
favour.example: Mimi did Leo a favour that night.

gem_stereotype.definition: A belief about a group that is applied to a person without looking at that person.
gem_stereotype.example: That sentence about men and women is a stereotype, and it settles nothing about the man in front of you.

low_hanging_fruit.definition: The easy results, available with little effort before the harder work.
low_hanging_fruit.example: We picked the low-hanging fruit first and delivered in three weeks.

mathlit_interpretation.definition: The meaning a reader gives a result in their own work once they have understood it.
mathlit_interpretation.example: The interpretation is the last step: the number is correct, and now it has to mean something on the night shift.
